definitionZh: *webkit-meter-bar CSS伪元素是一个WebKit扩展,代表一个米元素的背景. 它用于选择和适用于计量表容器的样式。
sourceDefinition: The ::-webkit-meter-bar CSS pseudo-element is a WebKit extension that represents the background of a meter element. It is used for selecting and applying styles to the container of a meter gauge.
